messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says (in Chinese): "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate something about hypothesis testing? They mention sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, null hypothesis mean 98.6. They ask to compute the standard deviation? Actually they say "計算...的零假設檢定的標準差" which might mean compute the standard error or the standard deviation of the sampling distribution? They likely want to compute the standard error of the mean: sigma/sqrt(n) = 1.4 / sqrt(40). That equals 1.4 / 6.3249 ≈ 0.2215. But maybe they want to compute the t-statistic: (98.2 - 98.6)/(1.4/√40) = (-0.4)/0.2215 = -1.805. Then compute p-value. The tool calculates p-value given sample mean, population mean, sample std dev, sample size, and two-tailed flag. So we can call the function with those parameters. We need to decide if it's two-tailed; default is true. So we call with sample_mean=98.2, population_mean=98.6, sample_std_dev=1.4, sample_size=40. The function returns p-value. Let's do that.
